b: Recording King has unveiled a new line of all-solid acoustic guitars designed to evoke iconic instruments of the "Golden Era" through traditional pre-war stylings. The RK Standard Series guitars are open, resonant, and responsive to each playing style, built to handle a heavy pick attack or lighter fingerstyle touch.

Every RK Standard model is thermo-cured to improve stability, clarity, and tone. Polished bullet-end frets, hand-selected rosewood fingerboards, and slim tapered necks aim to provide easy playability. The instruments have a “low-gloss” finish, a flat, super-thin coat that sits between satin and gloss, with a subtle silk-like sheen. Slim bindings, small pre-war-style tuner bushings, and real abalone inlays give the instruments a classic vibe.
Available in Dreadnought, OM, L-00, and 000 12-fret body shapes, key features include:
Solid AA North American Sitka, Solid African Mahogany, and Solid East Indian Rosewood Construction
Low Gloss Natural and Burst Finishes
Ships with a deluxe 25mm gig bag with embroidered logos
Dreadnought models include the D60, D60 Burst, D70H, and D70H Burst, each with 25.39” (645mm) scale length neck.
See the D60 Dreadnought in Vintage Burst demo video below:
Orchestra Model highlights models include the OM60, OM60 Burst, OM70H, OM70H Burst, each with 25.39” (645mm) scale length neck.
000 12-Fret models include the 00060, 00066 (All Mahogany), 0070H, each with 25.39” (645mm) scale length neck.
L-00 Bluesmaster models include the BM60, BM60 Burst, BM60 Marmalade Burst, BM60 Sepia Burst, BM70, BM70 Blacktop, each with 24.80” (630mm) scale length neck.
See the BM70 00 Bluesmaster Blacktop demo video below:
The RK Standard Series continues the revitalization of the Recording King brand under the direction of St. Louis Music.

Recording King’s Standard Series models carry street prices ranging from $749.99 to $999.99 depending on tonewood and finish. Burst finishes cost an additional $50 and Rosewood construction costs an additional $200 for all models. For more information, visit recordingking.co.
